items.text: My partner and I found this little gem, the perfect romantic retreat. It is a short drive to Cradle Mountain,  where we found ourselves one afternoon. Dom prepared us a lively private dining experience which included lots of local tassie the produce. The farm is very peaceful and private, only the best sunrise you’ll see to wake you the next morning. We will be back again soon for a longer stay. Thanks Dom !

Maria goes out of her way to make your stay in Porto a succes. She knows a lot of the city and a lot of people in the city. At the last moment she arranged front row seats for the CL match between FC Porto - Chelsea. Her house lies in the old center of Porto; 25 min walk from all the sights and nice places of Porto. We definately will go back.
The owner Robert is very considerate and always trying to provide us with the best experience. I’d like to live here again next time.

Very spacious double bed room with a large bathroom.  Super clean and quiet and a lovely place to rest your head after a day at the cliffs.  just a few minute walk from the pubs.  Lots of spacious parking and a great host.

Michele was extremely clear and gave us all the instructions for the check-in and the check-out. His flat is absolutely amazing, located in the very center of Naples and with an INCREDIBLE view from the living room and the bedroom. I absolutely recommend Michele’s place for anyone that would like to travel in Naples!  Thank you very much Michele!

Naprostá spokojenost. Ubytování splnilo ba i předčilo moje očekávání. Nádherný byt, elegantně zařízený se skvělým výhledem a výbornou dostupností. Vše nachystáno, domluva a komunikace též dobrá. Pokud to bude možné rád zopakuji.

Wir waren mit der Unterkunft sehr zufrieden! Die Einrichtung ist sehr einfach gehalten, was für den Preis aber angemessen ist. Die einzige Abweichung von der Beschreibung waren die "kostenlosen Parkplätze auf der Straße", die scheinbar nur Montag bis Freitag 8-18 Uhr da sind (falls ich das richtig verstanden habe, wir haben nur auf 2 h begrenzte gefunden). Das war leider zum Abstellen des Autos ungeeignet. Bezahlte Garage in der Nähe. Wie beschrieben, liegt die Unterkunft mit tollem Ausblick über den Dächern Barcelonas, was jedoch logischerweise dazu führt, dass man einen steilen Fußmarsch und einige Treppen in Kauf nehmen muss, um sie zu erreichen. Auch die U-Bahn Station liegt nämlich auf einem deutlichen niedrigen Niveau. Für Leute die nicht all zu gut zu Fuß sind könnte das anstrengend werden. Man wird jedoch wie gesagt mit einem tollen Ausblick belohnt. Die Wohnung liegt sehr ruhig und ist vollständig mit Rollläden ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation lief sehr unkompliziert ab.

you can't get anything better for this price. the place is bigger than what the pictures show, bathroom is good sise for Paris and also clean. Beds are incredibly comfortable and the temperature of the rooms is just the perfect one for sleeping. Again, it is nearly imposible to get something this good in Paris for the same price.

L'appartement de Barbara était immense et bien décoré, accueillant. Barbara est une personne très sympathique, arrangeante sur les horaires d'arrivée.  L'appartement est à environ 15 min à pied de la Plaça Catalunya et non 5 min comme indiqué. Le 1er Metro est à environ 10 min à pied. Il y a pas mal de restos autour de l'appartement. La taille de l'appartement est à conseiller plutôt pour 4 personnes minimum. On était 2 et ça ne nous a pas posé de problème.  Les chambres sont côté rue donc assez bruyant (on entend les voitures passer et les gens parler). Nous avons passé un bon séjour dans l'appartement de Barbara.

The location was great! Within walking distance to everything, and right next to a parking garage. Parking is not included, which we missed the memo on. Amanda was kind enough to provide us with some recommended garages when we asked, and we chose the one that is directly connected to the apartment building. Ye be warned though: the garage overcharged us both evenings we stayed there, making our parking budget spike to $80 ($40 per night) rather than our assumed $30 ($15 per night, as it read).  The apartment was immaculately kept with a few pretty little details and a very comfortable bed. As would be expected, the downtown area is pretty loud at night and in the mornings.  Thanks for a great stay, Amanda!
Judy and Mike’s guesthouse is a perfect home away from home while visiting Nashville.  All of the amenities are phenomenal. We cannot wait to stay there again.

Tia is lovely and so very helpful. However, the place was described as being in a great location and we felt unsafe with the graffiti on shutters of flat and so many people directly across from flat clearly living homeless along the canal, as well as not being very accessible to the ‘hustle and bustle’ - we didn’t know Berlin so the area was a guess. The flat we found wasn’t as clean as we’d like or have experienced with air BnB before, which we were disappointed with. Having said that, Tia is amazing herself; recommending so many things for me to plan for my husband’s birthday while we were there.  She didn’t even get upset at me for breaking one of the glasses from the kitchen!

We really enjoyed our stay at Sarah's place. Right by the water with lovely views of the estuary and a gorgeous little garden, the house is situated in an ideal spot, tucked away above the road.  The house has a lovely big sitting room, with a wood burning stove that is useful if it gets a bit chilly in the evenings. There is also a nice spacious living room and a very comfy sofa for reading in front of the fire or for curling up and reading the paper with a cup of tea in the morning! The beach is a short walk away and Rosscarbery is only a 10 minute walk with easy access to restaurants, pubs and a hotel. There are a few other lovely wild beaches a ten minute drive away and you could easily spend all day going from a wild walk on the beach to holing up in a lovely warm pub for the afternoon. There were lots of toys and books to keep the little ones entertained and a swing in the back garden which our 4 year old enjoyed immensely. It was a fabulous stay, and highly recommend booking!

Simply put, Maria's place was incredible. We managed to immerse ourselves in the local color immediately.  this is a very tight-knit close neighborhood with interesting stores in every nook and cranny in the area. From peeking into the local laundry wash house to walking along the marina at sunset this little town is a delight in a joy to behold. There are many different businesses that are run by the local residents so many that we did not even get to explore them all in the short time that we were there. The apartment itself is spotless with the usual amenities.  Be advised that  there is a steep staircase to navigate immediately upon entering the apartment. The bathroom itself is tiny with poor water pressure. Having a shower can be an adventure.   Maria is extremely responsive and friendly and gives excellent advice about the neighborhood. This apartment is well worth spending a few days.
Clean, cozy, well-stocked and great location. Kerri was a friendly and responsive host. Would come back in a heartbeat.

Frederic’s place is superb, especially for a solo traveller or a young couple. Perfect location for exploring the city and you can walk or catch the tram to most places in minutes. Fred is a really friendly and helpful host, he gave me excellent recommendations for restaurants and places to see. The apartment was immaculately presented and had great facilities like a coffee machine and cable TV. Highly recommend a visit if you’re in Bordeaux for work or just for fun. I hope to return again!

As the first time I was using Airbnb, I was a bit skeptic about the new experience I would go through, but Chris and Marie made me feel so comfortable. They invited me for lunch and gave me some nice traditional food, also they bought me a beautiful pair of jam jars and some other traditional desserts. Also they put a lot of effort to write me down some essentials, places where to go and describe the area! I really appreciated that. They made me feel like home and they were very welcoming! All my doubts went away and I knew things would go fine. They believed everything would go perfect, and so did I from that point :) Also they were so kind to let me in a few days earlier (no extra cost), so we could meet in person and handle things properly. This made it easier for me to integrate.  The pictures posted on the web were pretty accurate and I found the house even prettier in person. It was a cosy/ cute apartment that made u feel very comfortable. Clean and neat, everything a person would need to stay for a month in a new apartment. They let me use their things, so I didn't need to buy anything new (which would be inconvenient to take back home). The bed was big and great for me, al
Had an awesome stay at the apartment,will definitely recommend it.From checking in to checking out everything was smooth.
this condo is best condo in thailand for me，near by MRT，if i want to anywhere this condo is a best choose！
Amazing stay. What I loved the most was the fact that the linens were super clean. I would stay here again!

Melissa’s place is everything you’d ever want or need for a downtown Toronto vacation! We were so impressed with the location & proximity (cue: walking distance) to the CN Tower, Rogers Centre, Aquarium, Toronto Sign, Water Taxis and other attractions. This space is a perfect place to land after a long day of exploring and has even more amenities than are listed! There are some great restaurants right outside the door and Melissa was exceptional at providing local recommendations and communicating with us to make sure we were comfortable.  Bonus: The view from the balcony was a highlight for sure!! 🤩 12/10 recommend!

What a charming cabin and hostess in the gorgeous Santa Cruz Mountains! I booked The Lavender House for my modest, nature loving mother and her dog, Picket, who had to relocate while her old home was being worked on in nearby Saratoga. After moving them in, we explored and discovered all the thoughtful, delicious, and sassy amenities and details inside and out. All the stress had faded away from my mothers face before I left.  She was so happy and excited about the cabin, she invited my brother and his 5 year old son to visit with her and the horses. Her week long adventure at a higher elevation overlooking the horse arena, barn, and mountains was good for her soul and kept her close to home when needed.  "Toni is just a delight! She took incredible care of me and Picket, and treated us like dear old friends. She spoiled me with what I would call 'turn-down' service... I loved coming home to the cabin at sunset to find my wood stove fire started and fresh eggs in the fridge. The cabin inspired enjoying the sunrise, not to mention reading on the fenced in porch, at the artful desk, or on the comfortable couch or bed. It turned what started as a stressful relocation to a vacation
The place was amazing! My room was perfect and had everything I wanted. I was able to walk to many amazing places. I will definitely stay there again!

Angela was an amazing and fabulous lady. She was helpful, checked how things were  and replied very quickly to any questions.  The house is lovely, well equipped and spacious. Location is great if you are visiting Catania, Taormina or Mount Etna. We had a small incident and Angela was reasonable and we managed to solve the matter in a friendly way! Highly recommend to book if you are in Sicily. Thank you!!
great location. comfortable quiet apartment. well equipped. easy to find and right in the heart of the old town
Great place for our family for a spontaneous family trip out of Auckland. very helpful and responsive hosts and great place to stay. Would definitely stay again.

A very tidy and lovely Airbnb studio equipped with everything you need. A good bed and a nice bathroom. Virginia and Roy are great hosts and there when you need them, Very nice suburb , I had a great stay! Thank you Virginia

Great place , for US travelers just beware it’s on 5th floor - stairs, and no AC The place location in awesome, Oskar was great to communicate, also watch for taxi pickup, not an easy point for taxi pickup

We loved our host family! They we amazing to work with. They picked us up from the airport right away. The house was brand new and very clean. WiFi was very fast. The views were amazing! We loved that we could rent a car from our host. When they found out it was my birthday, the family gave me a very special gift from Mykonos...I loved that. We loved their dogs that would hangout with us in the house. We had wished the pool was heated but we were there at the beginning of October so the weather was a little cooler. Also would have liked a couple more kitchen items like a cutting board but felt like if we would of asked, our host would of gladly brought it.

This day was absolutely perfect, and the host could not have been kinder or more helpful. The pictures did not do it Justice. It was a lovely space very well cleaned and maintained with every amenity I needed. I will definitely be staying here. The next time I come to visit.  Her dog is the sweetest little guy and my niece and I fell in love with him. I was extremely pleased with everything, and it was an excellent value.

If you are looking for a beautiful place to relax and unwind - this is it.  The views are phenomenal.  In my opinion- this home is located on one of the best roads in the best area of Kauai. It's close to the food land, gas station, and the town of hanalei.  Only about 30 min drive to the tunnels.  About an hour to the airport.  An hour and half to poipu. And 2 hr to Waimea canyon.   Being from Maui, the beaches here are much different than I am accustomed to. The surf is higher here, the sand more course, and many many cliffs.  We were actually coming over to see if we would like to buy here.  The island is little too rainy and not as much activity as I would like.  However- the whole north side of the island is like "eye candy". Just gorgeous!!  The home itself was very nice, tastefully decorated, very comfortable, and safe. The linens appeared to be New as did the dishes.   There really wasn't anything needed that was not provided.  The whole kitchen was organized very nicely!   The view from the living room is of the yard and the water.   You are actually pretty close to the water, but since it's on a cliff- I was not able to hear the surf break. You should be safe in the rare

The apartment was in a great location very near the U5 so acessible to all areas in Berlin through the public transport system, surrounded by many shops and nice bars. Good clean and friendly area where we felt very safe. The apartment itself was extremely clean and check in and out was extremely easy. The beds were comfy and we comfortably slept and spent many hours with four adults in the space, no issues at all with the accomodation. We were welcomed with a handbook along with a welcome message online which provided us with information we needed, Karolina was very easy to get in contact with at all times and swiftly answered any of our queries. I would highly reccomend staying here.
The host was very friendly and helpful. The location is pretty good. Easy to get to Venice. In fact the flat is super small, but I wouldnt care much unless you plan to stay at home most of the time.

Sarah and Brain are both very friendly and kindly. They are patient to talk to me and introduce their house and family. That house is a tiny but very cozy. They prepare all thing what you may need. They have a very cute little girl and a cat.They have a very lovely family!

We've really enjoyed our stay in Philippe's apartment. He's been a great host, very responsive, friendly and accommodating. I'd like to highlight how clean the apartment was at our arrival, which was important for us. The decoration of the apartment is very stylish and we really felt like at home. Quiet neighbourhood, extremely comfy beds, high quality towels and bed linen and kitchen full of appliances. We couldn't ask for more and can't wait to go back. Thanks Philippe!

There were 3 of us traveling around Europe and found this apartment to be perfect for our needs. It is a short metro ride to downtown and a short walk to a really cool area of Vienna we wouldn’t have otherwise seen. Hannes met us at the apartment and offered us suggestions on where to eat and go out, as well as answering any other questions we had. We would definitely recommend!

The flat was just what we needed for our visit to Bristol. It was clean, the beds were comfy, the flat was warm and the parking space was so convenient. All the communication was good the instructions to find and enter the flat were clear and simple. Thanks Simon!

A wonderful apartment in a lovely area. It was really easy to use the public transport to get to the attractions and museums, and the piano bar on the street is great fun. The appartment is very well appointed and is stunning, we woukd definitely like to return in the future. The host was very friendly and helpful and the local recommendations were superb.
Such a great spot, such a good value. The hosts were very kind. The cabin is better than the pictures!! We had a blast.  The beach was great too !

This apartment is incredible!  We had a group of nine staying and there was plenty of room for everyone and comfortable beds for all. The space itself is very clean and well-kept, with great amenities, and the roof garden and terrace was spectacular. Our only regret was not being there in summer to enjoy the lovely outdoor setting and views over the city even more.  Giulia was very hospitable, offering any help we needed and, as she was next door, could have actioned immediately if required. There was a local tips and advice booklet made up in several languages, which was great.  The location of the apartment was very central, handy to a number of train lines and a short walk to the central station where we caught our airport bus.  My friends and I would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone thinking of going to Milan, especially in large groups, and have even discussed a return trip in summer!

Villa Haritomeni has everything to conquer your heart.  From the moment you arrive you notice that this villa is more than just a holiday home, you immediately feel at home.  The furnishing and decorations are so beautiful and authentic.  You can feel that this original family home is managed with a lot of love.  The house is equipped with every conceivable luxury and is very spacious.  The very spacious terrace with the many cozy corners between the beautiful plants is also a great asset.  The jetted pool is the perfect place to watch the beautiful sunset.  This villa has so many extras that you hardly find on airbnb.  For example, the towels were changed daily, the bed made and, if desired, the house is also cleaned.  The welcome pack with all kinds of goodies ensures that you are immediately in the holiday mood.  The wind provides natural cooling in the house so that you do not need the air conditioning (although it is there).  All windows and doors are fitted with solid fly screens.  In the bedroom you can open windows completely, so that you can enjoy the view and the fresh air from the bed, even during the night.  The villa is situated higher, so you have a view of the harbor

We stayed with my daughter at Florence’s place. It felt like an oasis of peace surrounded by nature. The property was very nice, lovely architecture, very comfortable practical and in very good shape. Florence was super helpful, available and welcoming. We’ll definitely be back!
Very nice place to stay, close to beach and many other touristy attractions. Host was very communicative and amazing!

Basile made me feel very welcome at his place. Everything was super clear and cosy. The location was very good in terms of connectivity, supermarkets etc. Basile was very flexible about arrival times too.  If Im ever gonna stay in Paris for a couple of days I'd be happy to be able to stay at his again!

Great location, nice apartment  (although sofas could do with a clean). Initial introduction not the greatest & apartment was not ready for us even though we were well past the check in time & had still not been cleaned properly.   definitely needs to provide more towels too, but apart from that , yes good apartment in a good location.
Excellent host. Great view on the sound. Walking distance to bars and restaurants. Definitely worth a stay!

I would definitely book here again. The beach is right down the street, and an awesome little cafe on the corner that had amazing breakfast. Jeff is a solid host with all the hookups and knowledge of the area. The room was very clean. Stop looking this is your place.
Perfect location! Very close to Washington’s monuments and attractions. Walking distance from several coffee shops and convenience stores. Really nice neighborhood, street parking always available.
Cannot say enough about this place it is exactly as advertised everything was flawless and look forward to returning sometime.

Ich habe mich vom ersten Moment an bei Marina sehr wohl gefühlt. Sie ist sehr liebenswert und ist immer ansprechbar. Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmacksvoll eingerichtet. Es ist alles da was man braucht, Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine, Mikrowelle, Wasserkocher, zwei Herdplatten, Fernseher, WLAN, sowie eine Klimaanlage. Die Stille, vorallem in der Nacht war so erholsam. Zum spazieren gibt es gleich vor der Haustür Wanderwege, die durch die wunderschönen Olivenbäume gehen. Ein grosser Gratisparkplatz gibt es zehn Min. zu Fuss. Ich habe mich in dieser Gemütlichkeit, dem Flair und der Stille, sowie mit der Gastfreundlichkeit von Marina sehr wohl gefühlt. Gerne komme ich wieder. Mi sono sentito molto a mio agio con Marina fin dal primo momento. È molto adorabile ed è sempre stata disponibile. L'appartamento è arredato con molto gusto. C'è tutto ciò di cui si ha bisogno, frigorifero, lavatrice, forno a microonde, bollitore, due piastre elettriche, TV, WiFi e aria condizionata. Il silenzio, soprattutto di notte, era così rilassante. Ci sono sentieri escursionistici proprio fuori dalla porta d'ingresso che attraversano gli splendidi ulivi. C'è un ampio parcheggio gratuito a dieci minuti a piedi. M
